Label 'FERREL CELL' (two lines) appears above 'HADLEY CELL' beside the middle loop.
Label 'POLAR CELL' (two lines) appears at top above 'FERREL CELL'.
Earth circle gets grey shaded fill with white continents (rotated landmasses) and gradient shading; loops and labels unchanged; single-frame onset.
